The skill was loaded, read, executed (validators spawned), and its output consolidated into the plan being submitted. Yet the gate LLM keeps citing the stale intent and reinforces itself with 'consistent with prior gate denials' (the two preceding plan-validate ellipsis denials), compounding the staleness. Same bug class as the previously-fixed 'stale-userMessageSnippet from two turns earlier' and sibling fixtures, surfacing via gate-LLM context: the LLM had been handed a stale intent + a streak of prior denials, and used both to deny a fresh call the user's actual workflow demanded.
